newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK businesspeople fined, banned for insider trades.
newsitem.headline: HK businesspeople fined, banned for insider trades.

text.p: Two former officers in a Hong Kong-listed company were fined and barred from management positions after a tribunal established they had participated in insider trading, the Hong Kong government said on Tuesday.
The tribunal found that Leung Wah-chai and his sister-in-law, Madam Butt Ching-han, engaged in insider trading in the shares of Yanion International Holdings Ltd between March 8 and May 12, 1993.
The tribunal heard that Butt sold Yanion shares in the three months prior to the release of disappointing earnings, avoiding a loss of HK$1.46 million.
Leung was ordered to pay HK$1.46 million and costs of HK$3.5 million. Both Leung and Butt were fined HK$2 million and banned from involvement in any listed company for one year.
